items.source: Called after a transactional event listener invocation.
items.translation: 事务事件监听器调用后执行。

items.source: Called before transactional event listener invocation.
items.translation: 事务性事件监听器调用之前调用。

items.source: event - the event that transaction synchronization is about to process
items.translation: event - 事务同步即将处理的事件

items.source: event - the event that transaction synchronization finished processing
items.translation: event - 事务同步完成处理的已发生事件

items.source: ex - an exception that occurred during listener invocation, if any
items.translation: ex - 如果在监听器调用期间发生异常，则为该异常。

items.source: Callback to be invoked on synchronization-driven event processing, wrapping the target listener invocation (TransactionalApplicationListener.processEvent(E)).
items.translation: 要在同步驱动的事件处理中调用的回调，它封装了对目标监听器调用（TransactionalApplicationListener.processEvent(E)）的包装。
